chapter: Mary Collins on Jelly Roll Morton and Willie the Lion
title: Willie the Lion's prejudice and claim to be Jewish
summary: Mary and Russell discuss Lion Smith's religious claims and bias against Morton, and compare Duke Ellington.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
